Highlights

Hair Highlights in Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout & Brookfield

Hair highlights in Bangalore add brightness, movement and dimension without changing your whole colour. Lighter strands are woven through your hair with foils, or painted freehand, so your natural base still shows through. Choose full highlights for an all-over lift, or a few targeted foils for face-framing pieces and subtle pops of colour.

At our Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Brookfield salons, every highlights appointment starts with a free shade consultation. Your colourist looks at your skin tone, base and colour history, then plans placement and tone, from soft caramel to golden blonde. Ask about Olaplex to protect lightened hair, and we confirm the price before we start. Our salons are close to Koramangala, Bellandur and Whitefield, so a refresh between visits is easy to fit in.

Good to Know

A Considered Hair Highlights Starts with a Consultation

The best service is not a one-size-fits-all appointment. Your stylist first understands your starting point, your preferences and the result you have in mind, then confirms the plan before beginning.

Your starting point matters

Your natural hair, skin or nails, together with any previous work and sensitivity, help us choose the right approach for the appointment.

Tell us what you are planning for

Whether this is regular care, a change of look or an occasion, sharing your timeline helps us recommend an appropriate session and aftercare.

A plan around your goal

Common reasons clients book include anyone who wants brightness and dimension without a full colour change, flat or one-tone hair that needs movement and texture, face-framing pieces or subtle pops of colour exactly where you want them. We tailor the service after seeing what will work best for you.

Aftercare

How to Make Your Hair Colour Last

  • Wait at least a couple of days before your first wash.

  • Use a colour-safe, sulphate-free shampoo.

  • Wash with cool or lukewarm water to reduce fading.

  • Use a heat protectant before blow drying, ironing or curling.

  • Protect your hair from strong sun and chlorinated water.

  • Book a hair spa or Olaplex treatment to keep coloured hair healthy.

  • First time colouring or have sensitive skin? Ask us about a patch test before your appointment.

FAQs

Hair Highlights FAQs

Still have questions?

Ask us on WhatsApp

  • Highlights are lighter strands placed with foils for brighter, more defined dimension, while balayage is painted by hand for a softer, blended finish. Highlights look crisper and more even; balayage grows out more gradually. Your colourist can combine both if you want brightness with a soft root.

  • Yes, you can book highlights per foil at Xing. It is perfect for face-framing pieces, a few bright strands around the parting or a subtle pop of colour. Your colourist will suggest how many foils you need during your free consultation at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield.

  • Any lightening can weaken hair, so highlights are done carefully, and we recommend adding Olaplex to protect the bonds inside the hair. Regular hair spas, colour-safe shampoo and a heat protectant keep highlighted hair soft and shiny. Your colourist checks your hair’s condition first.

  • Highlights do not wash out; they grow out as your hair grows. Most people refresh them every two to three months to soften the regrowth line and brighten the tone. A toner or gloss between visits keeps blonde and caramel shades from looking brassy.
